metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy (and fun!) way to strengthen and fix weak ankles.

This exercise can be done daily at home, and only requires a tennis ball. It's great for improving balance, coordination, strength, and stability in the ankle and foot.

Let us know how it works for you!
